verdict.rationale: CloudConvert is an API service, so pipeline-readable success/failure signaling applies. The evidence shows only fragments of it: a documented HTTP 429 status with a Retry-After header for rate limits, and real-time task updates over the Socket API. Both give machine-readable status rather than prose, but neither shows comprehensive error codes or failure semantics. Missing for 10: documented error/status code taxonomy for job and task failures, structured error payloads or logs, CLI exit-code behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
